rounds.summary: Found two behavior-preservation blockers and one minor coverage claim; all proposed resolutions independently confirmed in Round 2 and incorporated after convergence.

findings.summary: Shortcut field-isolation requirement would change existing global shortcut behavior.
findings.evidence: S-4 blanket field isolation conflicts with web/src/app.js guards: undo/bold/italic/link use inDocument but heading/application branches remain global.
findings.resolution: Preserved branch-specific inDocument/global shortcut scope, modifiers, capture and propagation; extended AC-4 with document/find/dialog target assertions.

findings.summary: Same-shape table fast path omits pending-focus exception.
findings.evidence: web/src/table-editor.js render requires editing && same shape && !focusAfterRender; row/column moves can request focus without changing shape.
findings.resolution: Preserved editing && same shape && no pending focus fast path, pending-focus precedence/consumption, null defaults and upper clamps; extended AC-8 with same-shape move destination/typing assertions.

findings.summary: Existing session-unit and outgoing JS tests do not prove Swift message-routing guards.
findings.evidence: tests/DocumentTests.swift invokes EditorSession directly; tests/bridge.test.js uses a no-op native sink; Sources/Margin.swift owns production frame/lifetime/payload/session checks.
findings.resolution: Corrected session-unit/outgoing-JS coverage claims; AC-2 requires focused production routing guard tests if routing is extracted, without duplicating logic in test-only code.

rounds.summary: Confirmed all three proposed dispositions resolve prior issues; no new findings or blockers. Critique converged before synthesis.

finalReview: Synthesized after independent Round 2 convergence; reviewed final spec against original intent, all eight unchanged Qlty findings, accepted F-1/F-2/F-3 dispositions, inspected source/test/build contracts and one-to-one AC-1 through AC-9 validation mappings. Original intent and original SHA-256 remain exact. Shortcut target routing preserves existing editor/global scope; table redraw retains the pending-focus exception; native routing validation now distinguishes session unit policy, outgoing protocol tests and actual production checks. All findings resolved and Open decisions is None. Domain splits, existing runtime/protocol/persistence/undo semantics, measured fallback boundaries, strict threshold targets and no-suppression requirement remain. No application code was changed. Scores for extracted files, full regression/build outcomes, desktop caret/composition and visual/native interactions remain future implementation evidence, not results established by preparation. Existing eight smells remain until implementation; unrelated workspace execution tooling changes are outside scope.
